ops.text: cc-guides cannot render a fragment change against a local checkout before it lands on main, so every consumer of a shared fragment has to ship blind and verify afterwards. Concretely: cc-context's AGENTS.md is a rendered artifact whose layout sources the ccx entry list and Version control section from `github:yasyf/cc-skills@main`. After editing the true sources in a local cc-skills checkout, there is no way to preview or land the resulting artifact. A path-scoped render refuses, because the lock pins the `github:` source and `--source cc-skills=<localdir>` demands a full no-path render to re-resolve. The full render with that override then aborts on its very first artifact with `unknown fragment: cc-skills:settings-base (kind json)` — a localdir source doesn't serve the json/sh-kind shared fragments the way the `github:` source does, so the override is unusable in practice even though the md fragments it was pointed at are fine. Nothing is written on the abort (lock, artifact, and `cc-guides check` output all unchanged), so it fails safe, but the net effect is that a correct fragment edit leaves the artifact STALE with no sanctioned way to converge it, and the only remedies are to hand-edit the generated file (which the cc-guides hook correctly blocks) or to merge unverified and fix forward. Making localdir sources resolve non-md fragment kinds would close it.
